scope: Post-review exploratory follow-up after original outcomes were known; not an independent confirmation or external preregistration
pair_reason: Same fixed pair used by the original search-seed sensitivity; no new outcome-driven pair selection
identity_objective: Cross entropy plus mean squared physical parameter deviation from identity normalized by maximum allowed deviation, lambda=1; 16384 original candidates plus identity; 500 Adam updates at 0.01
parameter_selection: One fixed weight selected by unit-scaled penalty convention, no hyperparameter sweep or selection on outcome
baseline_on: Provider mapping retained; activate sqrt(max(RMS^2-rest_mean_square,0)); retrain source with original settings
literal_mapping: Use original upstream get_images, including first-row removal and time reversal in segmentation and frame extraction; subtraction remains inactive; retrain source
scoring: rep0 calibration only; other reps held out; preserve original trial identities; separate frozen reference within each preprocessing variant
retention: All participants, gestures and variants retained regardless of result; no changes to original files
verification: Reload every adapted checkpoint; predict with batch257 vs1024; exact frame agreement; compare trial votes; no frozen classifier/buffer changes in regularized variant
